source.sourceType: manufacturer-checklist-pdf (official Topps checklist PDF, fetched from Topps's own cdn.shopify.com CDN)
source.note: Ingested for real via scripts/checklists/ingest-topps-pdf.js. The real source PDF prints only the CITY per row (no mascot, no trademark symbol). A deterministic, unambiguous city->team map (nfl-city-team-map.js) resolves single-team cities to their real full team name (team field); genuinely ambiguous 2-team markets (Los Angeles, New York) are left as the raw city text rather than guessed. sourceCity always preserves the real raw source value.
